name: Harriman Commons
summary: Harriman Commons is a community shopping center in Monroe, NY, managed by RD Management LLC. With extended operating hours and a strong 4.3-star rating from over 3,700 reviews, it serves as a convenient retail destination for Orange County residents.
demographics: Harriman Commons serves the Monroe and Orange County, NY market, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban communities. The trade area draws from households with moderate to above-average incomes who value convenient access to everyday shopping needs and services. Primary visitors include families with children, dual-income households, and retirees seeking a one-stop shopping destination for groceries, dining, and essential retail services in a convenient open-air format.
description: Harriman Commons is a well-established community shopping center located at 290 Larkin Drive in Monroe, New York, serving the Orange County region with convenient retail and dining options. Managed by RD Management LLC, a respected retail property management company with an extensive portfolio throughout the United States and Puerto Rico, this center has become a trusted destination for local residents seeking everyday shopping needs. The center operates with extended hours from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM, providing flexibility for busy families and working professionals. With a strong 4.3-star rating based on over 3,700 reviews, Harriman Commons has earned its reputation as a reliable community gathering place. The shopping center's open-air format and accessible location make it an ideal choice for convenient shopping in the Monroe area, reflecting RD Management's commitment to creating quality retail experiences that serve their communities.
